B4.reading: rules out only effects larger than the CI's upper bound; cannot drop B4

B2.reading: an 11-melanoma premise check detects only very large prevalence differences; it cannot refute B2, whose benefit (CoFiDA-M) comes from concept supervision as a whole, not from one feature's prevalence

B6.reading: 15 candidate subsets, 4 folds and strata of 5-30 lesions make a flip likely even if a true best subset exists; the tested form selected among V6's own members only, without per-epoch checkpoints. Not a test of B6 on V7 candidates.
